Case reference: 2014005452.CaseDesc: Albert Morris Hopkins departed his cabin on Sunday, November 2, 1975, to go fishing on Lake Athapapuskow in Manitoba. When he failed to return three days later, he was reported missing. Soon thereafter, on November 6th, his boat was located overturned banging against rocks. Despite intensive boat patrols and dragging operations, Albert has not been found. Foul play is not suspected, and it is assumed that he drowned.

Case reference: 2020009419.CaseDesc: On August 6, 1989, at approximately 12:00pm, Jessica Sakouhi was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Jessica was visiting from France and was due to return back on August 19, but she did not board the plane.

Case reference: 2013000071.CaseDesc: On July 5, 1993, Jean-Jacques Cantin was seen for the last time in the Ahuntsic district of Montreal, Quebec. His mother went to his apartment where she found packages that were prepared for different people. Jean-Jacques' personal belongings and clothes had disappeared.

Case reference: 2014002257.CaseDesc: James Clarke was last seen in Kemptville, Ontario on May 10, 1975. At the age of sixteen, James left his mother’s home, and his family have not heard from him since.

Case reference: 2021000674.CaseDesc: On December 30, 2020, Tyler Desorcy was seen for the last time in the 900 block of Pandora Avenue in Victoria, British Columbia. Tyler has no fixed address and he has not been seen or heard from by his family, which is out of character for him.  Tyler is known to walk with a notable limp.

Hair: Brown, Dark brown receeding hair with some facial hair

Case reference: 2014004969.CaseDesc: On July 21, 1966, a friend asked Ronnie Harper to help him remove one of his nets from the waters of Red Sucker Lake in Manitoba. The two men set off in a canoe and when they reached the spot, the men pulled on the line attached to the net, but it wouldn't budge. Increasing their effort, the men pulled harder and the line attached to the weight came loose. The sudden shift caused both men to lose their footing and the canoe to tip over. The men tried to push the canoe closer to shore. After a time, Ronnie told his friend that he was too tired to hold on. His companion pushed on. The survivor then realised that Ronnie was no longer holding on. Efforts to locate Ronnie were unsuccessful and he is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2016066833.CaseDesc: On April 26, 1982, an unidentified male was discovered in the Detroit River, near Fighting Island. His post-mortem length was estimated as being between 5'6"-5'8",  however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. It is estimated he was in the water for no more than 6 months.

Jacket: Parka or hooded jacket, which had both a zipper and snap fasteners

Case reference: 2017013576.CaseDesc: On December 6, 2016, Hellen Ermias and her daughter, Lina Tedros, were seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. All of their personal belongings were left behind in their apartment.

Case reference: 2014002270.CaseDesc: On 2 July, 1992, Behnam Amjadi was seen for the last time when he left his residence in the Côtes-des-Neiges et Notre-Dame-de-Grace district in Montreal, Quebec. Behnam has not been seen and has not contacted his ex-spouse or his brothers in Iran since.

Case reference: 2014006326.CaseDesc: Ronald Kay was reported missing to the Regina Police Service on November 26, 2013. He was last seen at the Saskatchewan Rough Riders Football game and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014032019.CaseDesc: On March 21, 1963, the dismembered remains of an unidentified man were found in burlap sacks on the side of the road near Pavilion, British Columbia. He had an old injury to his spine, likely causing pain and stooped posture, and was believed to have died a few months to years before being found.

Case reference: 2014030665.CaseDesc: On January 19, 1978, the partial remains of a female believed to be aged between 55-70 years of age, were found in the waters of the Salish Sea, southwest of Victoria, British Columbia. She had moderate arthritis and significant healed injuries to her left ankle and foot. It is believed she was deceased several months or even years before her remains were recovered

Case reference: 2014005583.CaseDesc: Mary Mark was a resident of east Vancouver in the 1970's. She did not apply for any government-issued identification or obtain social assistance, so information is very sparse on Mrs. Mark's life after 1975. It is believed that she met with foul play as the result of domestic violence. Her body was never recovered and the suspect is now deceased.

Case reference: 2014005330.CaseDesc: On September 13, 2009, at approximately 6:30 a.m., Rose Mackinnon was seen for the last time when she left the Earnestine Women’s shelter with her two children. Rose advised that she would be returning but has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2011762660.CaseDesc: Brittany Stalman was last seen on Crawford Drive, Delta, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014003380.CaseDesc: On May 9th, 1961, Brenda Byman was last seen on a hike with some classmates in the area of Wilmer, British Columbia, when she allegedly walked off into the bush and did not return. Brenda has not been seen or heard from since.

Jacket: Purple, Lavender, Mauve, Blue, Parka, With pink hood

Case reference: 2012020043.CaseDesc: Kate Carol Sieben was last seen on November 3, 2006 in Edmonton, Alberta. She left her residence on foot after an argument with her common-law husband. Kate had been threatening to leave for a few months, and had previously left home. On November 14, 2006, her parents reported her missing.

Case reference: 2014005121.CaseDesc: On May 10, 2008, Marie Claude Chrétien spent part of the evening at home building a campfire with neighbours in Cantley, Quebec. She was last seen by her next-door neighbour at around 11:30 p.m. No one has had any contact with her since and Marie Claude left no message or clue as to her whereabouts.

Teeth: False, Upper dental prosthetic and natural lower teeth

Case reference: 2014001102.CaseDesc: On March 4, 1973, the remains of a young adult man were recovered from the Burrard Inlet in Vancouver, British Columbia. He carried a Canada flag pocket knife and is believed to have been in the water for several months prior to the discovery.

Case reference: 2015064360.CaseDesc: Josephine Martin was last seen in the early morning hours of November 15, 2015, near Edwards Avenue in The Pas, Manitoba.  Extensive searches were conducted with no success.  Josephine follows a high-risk lifestyle, and her family and friends haven't seen or heard from her since, which is unusual.

Jacket: Columbia brand, buffalo check in red and black

Case reference: 2014005960.CaseDesc: On December 26th, 2012 at approximately 11:45 am Raymond Nothdurft was last observed near the Table Rock in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance, Raymond was despondent.

Hair: Brown, Grey, Short, Wears a moustache
Jewelry: Gold, Wedding Ring, Left Ring Finger, Three to four small diamonds in a diagonal
Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Ring, Right Little Finger, No lettering or logo
Scar: Right Knee, Small laparoscopic surgical scar on knee cap
Left Knee, Small laparoscopic surgical scar on knee cap
Tattoo: Right Ankle, Soccer ball with red maple leaf on outside

Case reference: 2020017934.CaseDesc: On May 15, 2020, Lebohang Nicol was seen for the last time in the area of 600 University Avenue in Toronto, Ontario. Lebohang is also known to go by the first name of “Toby.” He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2012020140.CaseDesc: Melina Martin of Sainte-Sabine, Quebec was last seen on January 23, 2005 at 1:30 p.m. in the Roch-Bourbonnais park in Farnham, Quebec.

Case reference: 2025060070.CaseDesc: On October 28th, 2025, Peter Jones was reported missing to the Abbotsford Police Department in British Columbia. His disappearance is considered highly unusual and has raised concern for both his family and the investigating authorities. On October 5, Peter was last seen on video footage in the 1900 block of McCallum Road at 2:49 a.m. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005112.CaseDesc: Tian You Li left his extended family home in East Vancouver to go for his routine walk. He never returned. He suffers from Alzheimers and may be confused and disorientated.

Case reference: 2014002695.CaseDesc: Harold Wagner was last seen on June 4, 1988, at Fur Lakes in the Mont Nebo district, Saskatchewan. Harold was swimming from his boat when he disappeared.

Shorts: Cloth, White, Red, White swim trunks with red, white and blue stripes

Case reference: 2008005999.CaseDesc: On September 8, 1978, Brian McLean and his co-worker, Russell Thomas, were commercial fishing at their camp on MacDowell Lake, near MacDowell Lake First Nation Territory. Russell advised that they left in separate boats to lift nets. He went to the west side of the lake and pulled four nets, then to the east side of the lake and lifted two more nets. He then realized that Brian was not there. Russell headed back towards the camp and found Brian's boat washed up against the shore approximately three or four hundred metres from the camp. The motor was in forward gear with the throttle off, and the paddle was missing from the boat. MacDowell Lake is 90 "air miles" north of Red Lake, and is accessible only by air. The area was searched, and the lake was dragged, but Brian McLean has not been found.

Pants: Oilskin, Green, Coveralls with blue suspenders
Amputation: Right Foot, all toes except big toe left

Case reference: 2007003699.CaseDesc: On April 9, 2007, a male was located in a forested area north of the intersection of Fiddlers Green Road and Glancaster Road in the community of Mount Hope, Hamilton. He is believed to have been deceased for 7 to 8 months and possibly longer.

Hair: Grey, White, Short, 2-3 inches in length
Teeth: Visible Missing, Upper teeth were lost or removed prior to death. Remaining teeth include 1 canine and 2 premolar teeth on each side of lower jaw
Money: $12.99 with one discolored coin, unknown denomination
Shirt: Denim, Blue, "Kinswood" brand long sleeved button down shirt, size large

Case reference: 2018071052.CaseDesc: On July 11, 1998, the remains of a male individual were discovered on Sulphur Mountain in Banff National Park. There is dental work present, including multiple fillings. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 6 months and 5 years.

Case reference: 2025054353.CaseDesc: On May 8, 1957, William Gatehouse boarded a bus and departed Winnipeg Manitoba, for a personal trip to Las Vegas Nevada, USA. On May 11, 1957, he telephoned his mother to inform her that he was experiencing difficulties in Salt Lake City, Utah. He requested that his brother contact a local lawyer in Winnipeg and arrange for funds to be sent to him in Salt Lake City.  A second call later that day suggested that he had resolved the issue, no longer required the money, and was continuing on his trip to Las Vegas.  There has been no further communication from William.

Case reference: 2020011563.CaseDesc: On July 17, 1988, at approximately 12:00pm, Mosses Korman was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2020011959.CaseDesc: On May 4, 1986, James Masten, Patricia Heys, Mark Smith, and Kimberly Masten were seen for the last time as they left Bluffer’s Park in Toronto, Ontario, on a 16-foot boat. The four were heading out onto Lake Ontario.

Scar: Right Eye, 2 inch scar over right eye

Case reference: 2018063238.CaseDesc: On January 20, 2001, Edward Pinarreto was seen for the last time when he left Toronto, Ontario, for a two-week vacation in Cuba. Edward was scheduled to return to Toronto on February 3, but never boarded his flight.

Case reference: 2014004068.CaseDesc: Alexandra Sawicki disappeared from her home in Mississauga, Ontario, on November 13, 2000. She was driving a burgundy 1998 Dodge Neon with 4 doors. Alexandra drove to Niagara Falls, Ontario and parked her car in the parking lot by the falls, where it was found abandoned by the Police later that evening. Alexandra may have been upset and distraught. She speaks fluent English, Romanian and Hungarian.

Scar: Eyes, Right side of the right eye

Case reference: 2006019199.CaseDesc: Marion Thiessen was reported missing by her husband in November, 1979. She has gone missing several times in the past and it has been discovered that she lived in Vancouver, British Columbia about 28 years ago.  She contacted an acquaintance in 1984, but there has been no contact with Marion Thiessen since that time.

Teeth: False, Partial dentures on both lower and upper teeth.

Case reference: 2018035793.CaseDesc: On June 25, 2018, Desmond Fischer was seen for the last time as he left his residence to go for a walk in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. Desmond is known for following a very strict routine, and his disappearance is out of character.

Case reference: 2006025899.CaseDesc: Robin Windross has not been seen since November 1977. He has an intellectual age of about 6 years old, speaks with a strong speech impediment and is difficult to understand. He may have left Huronia Regional Centre because he was concerned about being transferred in the facility to a unit with mostly adults. He had always been housed with children.

Case reference: 2013000092.CaseDesc: Jacques Boulanger was last seen on September 1, 1989 in Montreal, Quebec. Jacques loved sleeping outside even though he had a home and was a cabinetmaker in his spare time.  He might have a scar on his leg or foot.

Case reference: 2012020170.CaseDesc: An adult male was washed up along the south side of the beach at Stanley Park, near the 2000 block of Beach Avenue at English Bay in Vancouver.

Wallet: Black, Contained pliers and a jack knife
Mark: Forehead, Post mortem abrasion on the right side of the forehead

Case reference: 2016006093.CaseDesc: On January 19, 2016, Michelle Smits was seen for the last time as she travelled from Cambridge, Ontario to the United States. In February, Michelle’s vehicle was found abandoned in Boston, Massachusetts.

Case reference: 2014002175.CaseDesc: On October 29, 1983, Dale Dushinski was seen for the last time. During the time of his disappearance, Dale was canoeing on the Athabasca River. His canoe was later found overturned approximately 10 kms north of Fort McMuray, Alberta.

Scar: A scar from a biopsy, unsure which knee

Case reference: 2016017728.CaseDesc: Reid Chesney left a men's shelter in Halifax, Nova Scotia on April 4, 2016 and  has not been seen or heard from since. Reid lived a transient lifestyle and had very little communication with family members.

Case reference: 1996000260.CaseDesc: On March 17, 1995, Jay Boyle, Michael Cummings, Daniel Higgins, Jamie Lefebvre, Robert Rumbolt, and Chad Smith were seen for the last time walking towards the East Shore Marina in Pickering, Ontario. It is believed that the six young men boarded a boat that subsequently capsized.

Shoes: Red, Sneakers, Sneakers made of suede
Scar: Ears, Piercing scar on left ear

Hat: Black, Baseball hat-" Detroit Red Wings"

Shoes: Canvas, Black, White, Running shoes, brand "Adidas"

Case reference: 2013000040.CaseDesc: On July 16, 2002, Bruce Forbes was seen for the last time at a Regent Road residence in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Bruce suffered from a serious health condition, and required medication on a daily basis. It is believed that Bruce was not in possession of this medication at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014003388.CaseDesc: Janet Henry was a resident of Vancouver's downtown east side; she struggled with mental health and was engaged in a high risk lifestyle. Despite her challenges, Ms. Henry kept in frequent contact with her family. She was last seen on June 25, 1997, and was reported missing two days later.

Case reference: 2008019999.CaseDesc: Patrick O’Connell has been missing since July 4, 2008. He was last seen by a friend and roommate. Patrick suffers from a mental health disorder, and has challenges related to substance use. He is reported to have been despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2013000068.CaseDesc: On October 27, 1994, Yvon Ringuet was reported missing from his home in the Rosemont-La Petite-Patrie district in Montreal, Quebec. Yvon would call or visit his mother everyday. All his personal belongings were found in his home and no one has seen or heard from him since.

Tattoo: Cross, right or left upper arm

Case reference: 2014002313.CaseDesc: On April 5, 1986 Donald Smith was observed in the area of the Whirlpool Bridge in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance Donald was despondent and had trouble walking due to arthritis.

Teeth: False, Upper dentures and missing teeth
Amputation: Left Index Finger, Tip of left index missing

Case reference: 2010005899.CaseDesc: Mark Edmonson disappeared from his residence in Stoney Creek on October 3, 1999. Mark has not returned or contacted his family members since that time and both his family and Police are concerned for his well being. Mark is developmentally challenged. It is believed that Mark left home without taking any money or personal identification. Extensive police searches have failed to determine his whereabouts.

Pants: Blue, Jeans with hole in left knee

Case reference: 2015054215.CaseDesc: On October 03, 1996, James Bruce Hill-Tout, failed to show up for a family dinner in Calgary, Alberta.

Case reference: 2026007673.CaseDesc: Toward the end of November 2025, Roger Rochon was last seen in Joliette, Quebec, as he was getting ready to take the bus to Toronto, Ontario. The investigation revealed that he was in Toronto in early January 2026 because he wanted to explore and travel across Ontario.

Scar: Right Cheek, Superficial wound; a graze

Case reference: 2012020115.CaseDesc: Glen Moquin was last seen at a summer camp in Rouyn-Noranda, Quebec on August 9, 1993. Glen's clothes were located on the shore of the nearby lake Opasatica.

Case reference: 2006009199.CaseDesc: On July 09, 2003, Michael Linklater, his father and brother went to the Linklater family hunting & fishing camp; located near mile marker 115 on ONR Railroad line, between Cochrane and Moosonee. Michael left the camp at about 6:00 p.m. on July 12, 2003, and has not been seen since. His father and brother searched for hours before going to mile marker 126 and calling the police. An extensive search in the area has failed to locate him.

Case reference: 2014004477.CaseDesc: In June 1973, Ronald & Theresa Yakimchuk left Edmonton for a wedding in Montreal, driving their 1959 Volkswagen Beetle. It was reported the couple visited an associate in Brandon, Manitoba. They never attended the wedding. The last contact from the couple was a postcard believed to be from Theresa sent from Dryden, Ontario on June 12, 1973.

Jewelry: Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Braided, Wedding band
Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Braided, Wedding ring

Case reference: 2014001191.CaseDesc: On April 22, 2010, the body of an unidentified man was found in the Richelieu River in Saint-Mathias-sur-Richelieu, Quebec. In his possession were a "Hipstreet" brand MP3 player and headphones. The images shown are facial approximation portraits of this unidentified man created by the Sûreté du Québec.

Case reference: 2019075256.CaseDesc: On December 29, 2020 between 4:00 and 5:00 am, Joel Judd was last seen leaving a party at a residence in Slave Lake, Alberta.

Case reference: 2025024697.CaseDesc: On May 15, 2025, the Canadian Coast Guard Search and Rescue team found a sailboat belonging to Amber Nitchman washed up on the shore near 5362 Bayshore Road in Nanaimo, British Columbia.  Amber was a novice sailor who may have fallen overboard while operating the vessel.

Scar: Shoulders, Branding scar on the shoulder, unknown whether left or right.
Tattoo: Unknown, Feather on foot, unknown whether left or right

Case reference: 2014005155.CaseDesc: Harold Murray Harvey was seen for the last time by a neighbour in front of his residence in Pincourt, Quebec on September 14, 2008. Harold was reported missing by a family member on September 19, 2008. At the time of his disappearance Harold was taking medication, which he left behind. Harold had a history of leaving his home in the past but always returned after a couple of days.

Case reference: 2014004635.CaseDesc: In 1986, Sarah Skunk visited with family members located in Mishkeegogamang First Nation and Shabaqua, ON. Since that time, she has not been heard from by any family members. Family fears that she may be deceased. Sarah was known to frequent Vancouver BC, Sudbury ON, and Washington State, USA. Sarah spent some time on the streets. She was known by numerous aliases and may have had children.

Mark: Mouth, Wart on inside of mouth

Case reference: 2014005841.CaseDesc: Alfred Sassin has not been seen since he left his home in downtown Vancouver on July 9, 2012. Mr. Sassin's absence was reported to police by the resident caretakers on July 16, as they had not seen him for over a week, which was unusual for him.

Case reference: 2012020125.CaseDesc: Serge Crevier was last seen on July 17, 2006, around 1:30 p.m. at his residence in Gatineau, Quebec. The car that Serge was using, a grey Oldsmobile Alero 2002, was found on September 10, 2006 in Thorne, in the Outaouais region of Quebec.

Case reference: 2014004359.CaseDesc: On July 20, 2003, Stephane Gallant was last seen at the Shoreline Hotel in Thunder Bay, Ontario.  Stephane speaks French and English with a French accent.  Stephane worked in the logging industry as a woodcutter. On July 23, 2003, his vehicle, a 1984 GMC S10 blue pickup with a black topper, was located at the Trowbridge Falls campsite on Copenhagen Road in Thunder Bay, Ontario.

Case reference: 2006018499.CaseDesc: Tony Gikoff was last seen July 9, 1955, near Colborne, Ontario, at a property he rented to tenants. He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2009004899.CaseDesc: Sacha Latulippe left Montreal Airport for Mexico city on October 15, 2009. He advised his family he was leaving for business. Investigation revealed he had 2 wives in different towns and was leading a “double life”. He left with his business partner Eric Marcel on this same flight. Eric is also missing.

Hair: Blonde, Brush Cut, Spikey/gelled, natural brown; Sideburns

Case reference: 2014006135.CaseDesc: In December 2012, Victor Pedtchenko was last seen in the area of 55 Triller Avenue in Toronto, Ontario. Victor had not been seen for one month before being reported missing.

Case reference: 2018063443.CaseDesc: On July 2, 2003, at approximately 7:00 a.m., Sergio Rodriguez was seen for the last time by his wife in Toronto, Ontario. When Sergio’s wife had returned home from work, he and all of his belongings were gone.

Case reference: 2014002762.CaseDesc: On March 3rd, 1982, Laurence Peterson and Randolph Johanson were reported missing by Mr. Johanson’s girlfriend. Mr. Johanson and Mr. Peterson were last seen on February 28th, 1982, leaving the Shelter Island Marina, on their boats. Mr. Johanson was reportedly using his 26 ft. long salvage tug boat to haul Mr. Peterson’s 43 ft. wooden halibut fishing vessel to Lund, BC. The men were reported missing when they did not arrive at their destination. Extensive searches were unsuccessful. It has been speculated that the two men disappeared to start a new life.

Teeth: Other, Wide space in between the front teeth
Scar: Chest, 1 inch scar on left breast

Case reference: 2022041871.CaseDesc: On June 20, 1994, Johnny Baker was seen for the last time at his residence in Borger Texas, USA.

Scar: Left Eye, Over the left eye

Case reference: 2014006241.CaseDesc: On September 7, 2013, at around 10 am, Ranjit Singh was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Ranjit had travelled from India to visit Toronto and was due to return home on a flight scheduled for 5 pm, but he never boarded the plane.

Case reference: 2014004860.CaseDesc: Lesley Holmes was reported missing by her common law husband on December 23, 2005 after not having contact with her since November 23, 2005.  They had been living in a basement apartment in Toronto, the home of a friend. Lesley did not feel comfortable staying there without her common law who was away, so she moved out. She was believed to have spent some time in a shelter but this could not be confirmed by the shelter.  Her family has not seen or heard from her since that time.

Case reference: 2005004699.CaseDesc: On September 3, 1995, an unidentified woman was found in the Niagara River, near the Maid of the Mist Dock. She had adenomyosis, similar to endometriosis. She had peach/pink polish on finger and toe nails. She is estimated to have been in the water for a few days.

Teeth: Good condition with a few white fillings. Both lower first molars were extracted before death.
Jeans: Denim, Blue, Levi's Strauss, size 27 waist and 22 inseam
Jewelry: Gold, Gold, wearing a 14" chain with crucifix; European 9K gold; manufacturing mark of "ATS"
Scar: Abdomen, 12 cm surgical scar below the naval

Case reference: 2006017399.CaseDesc: On February 15, 1978, Mary Frances Gregory left her home in Parry Sound, Ontario, Canada, for a vacation in California, USA. She never arrived in Palo Alto and has had no contact with her family or friends since.  It is believed that Mary left Canada in a motor vehicle with a male acquaintance, who claims to have dropped her off at a bus station in Las Vegas, Nevada, around ten days after leaving Canada.  The driver claims to have travelled to Nevada via the US states of New York, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Illinois, Colorado, Utah and Arizona.

Mark: Right Abdomen, Brown, in shape of 5 cent piece (10mm)

Case reference: 2013000054.CaseDesc: On December 28, 2006, Carlisle Callum-Drummond was seen for the last time in the Cotes-des-Neiges -Notre-Dame-de-Grace district of Montreal, Quebec. Carlisle left from his home and it is possible that he may be with his father, who is also missing.

Case reference: 2014002991.CaseDesc: On August 23, 1988, Roberta Ferguson and eight other youths went to Sunnyside Campground at Cultus Lake in Chilliwack, BC. On August 24, 1988, Ms. Ferguson left the group on foot, it is believed she intended to return to her home in Surrey, British Columbia. Witnesses reported having seen a female walking on Columbia Valley Road, and others reported having seen a female getting into a vehicle at the intersection of Vedder Road and Cultus Lake Road. Ms. Ferguson has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2006021599.CaseDesc: Zbigniew Gajda left Thunder Bay on his snowmobile to go ice fishing on Lake Superior.  He was last seen on January 4, 2001 around Caribou Island Point.  It is thought that his snowmobile may have gone through the ice.

Jacket: Black, Purple and blue on arms

Case reference: 2014002370.CaseDesc: On June 16, 1997, at approximately 4:30pm, Kelvin Zdarski and two friends left Dauphin, Manitoba and drove to a cabin near Waterhen, Manitoba. During the evening there was an argument between the men. Kelvin left the cabin and never returned. The men looked for him on their way back to Dauphin but did not see him. On June 17, around 7:30am, a man fitting Kelvin's description was seen walking on a local road. An extensive search by land, air and water proved unsuccessful. Kelvin did not take his wallet, money or identification with him and had no means of transportation.

Scar: Left Calf, 1 inch long, back of calf

Case reference: 2014004253.CaseDesc: On October 13, 2000, two boats set off on the Churchill River, bound for Granville Lake in Manitoba. One of the boats began taking on water and experiencing engine trouble. Most of the occupants of the disabled boat transferred to the other boat. However, William Linklater stayed on the disabled boat, attempting to start it. The missing boat was located the next day; however, William was not aboard. He is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2014004887.CaseDesc: On October 10, 2005, Saberi Gilchalan Ghassem was last seen in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004979.CaseDesc: On July 23, 2007, Gad Krespine, a resident of Montreal, was last seen at approximately 10:30 A.M., at 1755 Lierre Street in Laval, Quebec.

Case reference: 2018070318.CaseDesc: In the summer of 1983, Angela Hartmann left home to travel to Ottawa, Thunder Bay, and Calgary before attending fall classes at Trent University in Peterborough, Ontario. It is believed that Angela's last known location was in August of 1983 in Ottawa, Ontario at the Ottawa Youth Hostel.

Case reference: 2008003299.CaseDesc: On May 17, 1985, Cyril Cheong was fishing on White Lake with his friends when the weather deteriorated and strong winds started to blow. Cyril's boat capsized and his friends were unable to save him.  One of his friends saw him, approximately 2 to 3 feet under the water, beyond his reach.

Case reference: 2025011842.CaseDesc: Gabriel Simard was reported missing as of March 11, 2025, in the waters of the St. Lawrence River near Les Bergeronnes, Quebec. Gabriel departed from the municipal dock with his 16-foot canoe to retrieve his fishing cabin from the waters of the river. At approximately 6:00 p.m., Gabriel contacted his father via mobile phone to inform him that he was unable to tow the cabin back to shore due to the strong winds. An hour later, Gabriel contacted his father once more to request that he contact the emergency services, as he was unable to return to the dock and was being swept towards the open sea. Despite a thorough search, the whereabouts of Gabriel remain unknown.

Jacket: Synthetic, Brown, Black, Camouflage, hunting vest

Case reference: 2014005786.CaseDesc: Giuseppe Renda was last seen on May 4, 2012, at approximately 12:30 p.m., on Saint-Viateur Street West in the Plateau Mont-Royal borough of Montreal, Quebec. Giuseppe lived in the Westmount District, and was a discreet man who did not leave his home often.

Case reference: 2023067749.CaseDesc: On November 27, 1989, Thomas Nightengale was last seen in the area of the Upper Niagara River in Niagara Falls, New York, USA. Thomas was despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014003900.CaseDesc: On December 8, 1977 at approximately 3 p.m., Ronald Foucault left his father’s business located in the city of Blainville, Quebec and told his father he had to travel to Texas, in the United States for work. There has been no news from Ronald since this time and it is impossible to confirm his arrival in the United States. In 1979, some of his belongings were found near the Dorval airport in Montreal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014002850.CaseDesc: On May 21, 1997, Ardavan TAHERZADEH last communicated with his parents while he was backpacking in India, indicating that he wished to explore more of the country. Ardavan was a University of British Columbia student who took a year off to teach English as a second language in Korea and travel extensively in Northern India.  His last call was from Koshla, Kullu Province in India. On June 28, 1997, Ardavan was reported missing to the West Vancouver Police Department by family after he missed his flight home on June 25, 1997. We have not received any communication from Ardavan since.

Case reference: 2022055316.CaseDesc: Jesse Strongarm was last seen in November 2021 in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. At the time of this disappearance, Jesse was living a high-risk lifestyle. After communicating with a friend in December 2021 Jesse has not been heard from since.

Case reference: 2015033938.CaseDesc: On the morning of June 27, 2015, Curtis Wilson was seen for the last time by a friend in Kelowna, British Columbia. Curtis had travelled from Alberta to British Columbia in a black rental car, model Chrysler 200. Subsequently, the rental was recovered in an area off Cosen Bay in the Kalamakla Provincial Park in Coldstream, British Columbia.

Shirt: Black, TSHIRT, Orange logo on front of shirt
Tattoo: Right Forearm, Skull in top hat 'Wicked'; skull outer forearm
Right Forearm, Skull with snake through it, $$ signs & flaming skull
Left Chest, Eagle head; upper chest
Left Forearm, Red & black scorpion on inside forearm
